recipe.title: Recipe
recipe.description: Steps saved from an earlier file.

Choice.title: Choice
Choice.description: One answer to an ask-tier question.

ClearValuesStep.title: ClearValuesStep
ClearValuesStep.description: Blank out values that match a condition, keeping the rest of the row.

position.title: Position
position.description: Zero-based position among the file's columns.

role_confidence.title: Role Confidence
role_confidence.description: How sure the role guess is, from 0 to 1.

role_note.title: Role Note
role_note.description: Plain-language reason for the role, suitable for a hover note.

uniqueness.title: Uniqueness
uniqueness.description: Distinct values divided by filled values.

min_value.title: Min Value
min_value.description: Smallest number or earliest date, when typed.

max_value.title: Max Value
max_value.description: Largest number or latest date, when typed.

sample_values.title: Sample Values
sample_values.description: Up to 5 of the most frequent values.

match_rate.title: Match Rate
match_rate.description: Share of filled values that match, from 0 to 1.

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: Extra context, e.g. the placeholder text "N/A", a code shape "AAA9999", or the separator "-".

DigitsFewerThanCondition.title: DigitsFewerThanCondition
DigitsFewerThanCondition.description: Filled values with fewer digits than `count`, e.g. phone numbers that are too short.

HeaderMode.title: HeaderMode
HeaderMode.description:
Whether the first row holds column names.

AUTO guesses from the values; the other two let the user override the guess
(the "first row is data" toggle).

MergedNote.title: MergedNote
MergedNote.description: A spelling that now counts as another: "sales" folded into "Sales".

PhysicalType.title: PhysicalType
PhysicalType.description: The dominant shape of the values. Storage is always text.

RecipeOutcomeView.title: RecipeOutcomeView
RecipeOutcomeView.description: What came of re-using steps saved from another file.

sheet.title: Sheet
sheet.description: Excel sheet; None means the first one.

RewordedCopy.title: RewordedCopy
RewordedCopy.description: The title and explanation a card should show, once a rewrite was accepted.

StepContribution.title: StepContribution
StepContribution.description: Steps that moved one answer, and how far the answer goes back without them.
